name: CSS Cover Flow
description: The classic iTunes-style 3D cover flow rebuilt with zero JavaScript: a horizontal snap scroller where each cover rides its own animation-timeline view(inline), rotating sideways off-center and popping forward at dead center, with a CSS box-reflect sheen below.
usage: Include styles.css, then add a <div class="scf" role="region" tabindex="0"> wrapping a <ul class="scf-covers"> where every <li> holds one square .scf-cover (an img, inline svg, or styled div). Tune the shelf with --scf-cover-size and --scf-span on the .scf element.
